name: logic-tree
description: Manage a hypothesis/issue/decision tree using Git branches as memory. Supports creating, viewing, and pruning tree nodes.

proceed_when: Need to structure a complex problem
Creating a hypothesis tree for diagnosis

constructor.input:
context:
  root_concept: string      # The root problem or idea
  working_directory: string # (Optional) Git repo path
process:
IF NOT inside_git_repo:
    RETURN {proceed: false, reason: "Must be run inside a git repository"}
RETURN {proceed: true, reason: "Ready to manage logic tree"}

execute.input:
action: "add" | "view" | "prune" | "checkout"
params:
  name: string         # Node name (for add)
  parent: string       # Parent path (e.g. 'root/branch1')
  path: string         # Path for prune/checkout (e.g. 'root/branch1')
  content: string      # Description or content for the node
process: Step 1: Determine the action required (view, add, prune, checkout).
Step 2: Execute the corresponding command using the Tree Manager.
Note: For root node, omit --parent or use existing root name.
